title: The Slop Index
what: new English web pages of 150 words or more, archived at 46 crawl points from 2019 to 2026

markup.label: Date declared in the page's markup

text.label: Date read from the page text

limits.note_sites: Too few sites appear in both the 2019 and the 2026 crawls to follow the same sites over time; each crawl is a fresh sample of the web.

method.difference_rule: a difference is called clear when the 95% bootstrap interval on it excludes 0
